name: cloudflare-email
description: Cloudflare temp mail agent skill for reading inbox messages, fetching parsed mail, and sending email with an Address JWT.

interface.shortDescription: Read and send Cloudflare temp mail with an Address JWT.
interface.longDescription: Agent skill for cloudflare_temp_email deployments. It validates an Address JWT, lists parsed inbox messages, fetches a specific parsed mail, sends email when sending is enabled, and documents the raw-mail fallback path.
defaultPrompt: Use my Cloudflare temp mail JWT to list recent emails.
Fetch this temp mail message by id.
Send an email through my Cloudflare temp mail deployment.
